description: Single-shot LLM agent with MCP tool support (via LiteLLM — works against 100+ providers). Runs a tool-calling loop until the model returns a final answer or max_iterations is hit.

outputs.description: Agent run dict: {final_answer, iterations, tool_calls_made, tool_call_details, transcript, stopped_reason, model, mcp_servers}

include_reasoning.label: Include Reasoning
include_reasoning.description: Reasoning models (Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, ...) inline <think>...</think>. The thinking is always stripped from the transcript and final_answer; when true it is also returned as a 'reasoning' key in the result dict (all iterations joined) and as asset metadata.

prompt.label: User Prompt
prompt.description: User prompt sent on the first turn.

mcp_servers.label: MCP Servers
mcp_servers.description: List of MCP servers to expose as tools. Each tool name is prefixed with the server name (e.g. fs__list_files). Each entry is declared inline (name + transport fields) or shared via server_resource_key (an MCPServerResource component's resource_key) -- exactly one of the two per entry.

name.description: Tool-name prefix. Required when declaring the server inline; leave unset when using server_resource_key.

url.description: http / sse: full URL of the MCP endpoint

env.description: stdio: extra env vars for the subprocess

headers.description: http / sse: literal HTTP headers (avoid secrets — use headers_env)

headers_env.description: http / sse: map of header_name → env_var_name; header value is read from the env var at materialization time

server_resource_key.description: Resource key of an MCPServerResource component to use instead of declaring this server inline -- lets several agent components share one registered server. Exactly one of `name` (inline spec) or `server_resource_key` is required.

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Tags

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Lineage-Only Deps

reasoning_effort.label: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning-model effort level: 'low' \| 'medium' \| 'high'. Forwarded to OpenAI o1/o3 and Gemini 2.5+ reasoning models (silently dropped for other providers).

thinking_budget.label: Thinking Budget
thinking_budget.description: Max reasoning-trace tokens. Forwarded to Gemini 2.5+ (native `thinking_budget`) and Anthropic thinking mode (auto-mapped to `thinking: {type: enabled, budget_tokens: N}`). On Gemini, set 0 for short structured outputs to avoid silent truncation (thinking tokens draw from `max_tokens`). Silently dropped for OpenAI / Groq / other non-thinking providers.

prompt_caching.label: Prompt Caching
prompt_caching.description: Anthropic prompt caching. When true AND the model is Anthropic-family (claude / anthropic / bedrock/anthropic.), wraps the system prompt with `cache_control: {type: ephemeral}` so subsequent runs within ~5 min hit the cache. Big win for long system prompts + MCP tool schemas that repeat across loop iterations (~90% cheaper on cached prefix). Silently ignored on non-Anthropic providers.

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

skill_keys.label: Skill Keys
skill_keys.description: SkillResource resource_keys (from SkillResourceComponent) to make available to this agent. Each listed skill's name/description go into the agent's context up front; the full SKILL.md only loads if the agent actually calls load_skill.

allowed_tools.label: Allowed Tools
allowed_tools.description: Optional allowlist of namespaced tool names (e.g. 'dagster_plus__list_runs'), '*' wildcards supported (fnmatch), applied across every mcp_servers entry. Default: all discovered tools. A server can expose many tools the agent shouldn't be able to call (e.g. a hosted Dagster+ MCP server's terminate_run/rerun_run/delete_alert_policy alongside read-only ones) -- this is the lever to restrict an agent to a safe subset, e.g. ['dagster_plus__list_*', 'dagster_plus__get_*'].
